frame_image_note: Video co hieu ung quet sang (light-wipe) trai-sang-phai o dau: con vet mong sat canh phai o frame 18, het han ngay sau do. Lay frame 20: bo cuc day du va 'nguyen ven' (san pham dat tren be xoay, van con nam duoi chup thuy tinh, tay nguoi vua cham toi vien chup, nen gradient xanh-hong lam mo phia sau), chua co chuyen dong nhac chup len (dong tac nhac chi bat dau ro tu ~frame 28-30).
effect_prompt: A human hand reaches in from the top of frame and lifts a clear glass dome cover straight up and away from the product, revealing it fully. After the dome is removed, the round pedestal slowly rotates like a turntable, smoothly turning the product in place through a full rotation to reveal it from every angle, while the camera itself stays completely fixed. Soft, dreamy teal-to-peach gradient bokeh background throughout, gentle studio lighting, photorealistic advertisement cinematography.
effect_prompt_note: Qua cac frame 20->30: tay nguoi nhac chup thuy tinh thang len va ra khoi khung (frame 30 chup da nang len, frame 45 chup gan ra khoi khung tren). Sau khi chup duoc nhac di, be xoay (pedestal) tiep tuc quay tron nhu turntable: frame 60 thay mat sau/got, frame 75/90/105/120 lan luot thay cac goc nghieng va mat truoc san pham -- xac nhan la be xoay chu khong phai camera orbit (nen gradient mo phia sau khong doi huong/vi tri, chi co san pham xoay tai cho). Nen gradient xanh-hong giu nguyen tong mau xuyen suot, khong cycle mau manh nhu neon.
image_prompt: A glass display dome on a peach pedestal holds the single product from image 2, standing upright in the center of the pedestal, fully inside the glass dome, in the spot where the shoe was. The product rests on its base on the pedestal surface, with a soft contact shadow beneath it. The product is about the same size as the shoe and fills the middle of the dome. The product keeps the exact shape, proportions, colors, materials, logo and all printed text of image 2. The curved glass of the dome in front of the product shows soft reflections and highlights, and the lighting on the product matches the soft pastel light of image 1. The hand, glass dome, pedestal and background stay the same as image 1.
